verdict.rationale: Bugbot documents repository-level `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files for project-specific review guidelines and organization-wide rules that team admins create in Bugbot Automations. A verbose mode shows which rules were loaded into each review, which covers the natural-language rules path of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of AST/structural pattern rules, any evidence of referencing linked external style guides, and independent or hands-on confirmation that custom rules are actually enforced in reviews.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I encode my team's own review guidelines — natural-language rules, AST patterns, or linked style guides — and the reviewer enforces them

citations.quote: Create `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files in your repository to give Bugbot project-specific review guidelines.
Team admins can also create organization-wide rules in [Bugbot Automations](https://cursor.com/automations/from-cursor/bugbot).
Bugbot replies with a table of the rules included in that review
